    "Research": (1, {"Omar", "Farid"}, "S11"),

    "Roadmap": (1, {"Gus", "Nikhil"}, "S16"),
    "Budget": (2, {"Marco", "Nikhil", "Omar"}, "S17"),
}

    add((day[m] >= 1) & (day[m] <= 4), "S1,S8")
    add(end[m] == start[m] + duration, "S4," + sentence)
    add((start[m] >= 9) & (end[m] <= 17), "S3,S4")
    add((end[m] <= 12) | (start[m] >= 13), "S5")
